rawContent: Utterly pernicious "satire." Leftists all on board with destroying all the Alex Jones archives, wholly banning him, are shooting themselves in the gut. Little imagination is required to see the same "morally clear" reasoning applied to, e.g., #BDS or #BLM.
@Nostrastevus @BenjaminPDixon The "anti-cop" rhetoric of #BLM "leads to killing or danger to law enforcement." See how that works?

@Nostrastevus @BenjaminPDixon There certainly is an urge to go in that direction, but no, so far there has not been wholesale banning of #BLM, but there *has* been censorship of pro-Palestinian/BDS supporters. Alex Jones is NOT WORTH pouring gas on that fire with this "hard case, bad law" precedent.

Absolutely, #BLM is dangeorus to and kills cops, #BDS and pro-Palestinians are antisemitic conspiracy theorists; let the Silicon Valley keepers of the public square quash them all. #logicofprogressiveswhosupportinfowarsbanning
If you support banning Alex Jones you've endorsed the precedent for banning these #BLM activists.

@BerniceKing @Kaepernick7 This is a false equivalence. I STRONGLY oppose the NFL's plantation treatment of its players, but the NFL simply isn't a **new public square** as the giant social media *are. They come for Alex Jones, then for #BLM (dangerous to cops, doncha know!?).

@BenjaminPDixon You really want to rely on giant social media's assessment of popular support for speech protection? Think #BLM and #BDS are going to win that? Do you suppose the 1st Am is a counter-majoritarian protection for a reason?

@BenjaminPDixon That "culture" is from whence come the legislators, lawyers and judges who decide what's "hate speech." No getting around how it always works -- never ultimately as anything but bad for the left. (Does #BLM publish "hate speech" dangerous to cops?)

@UltimaOla @ggreenwald !! Are you seriously claiming that I don't rail about censorship against pro-Palestinians?! If so, you have zero idea of my views and history. I oppose censorship b/c it will strengthen attempts to silence #BDS and #BLM, and others.

@LyleBoggs @UltimaOla @ggreenwald And among those w/ no large platform, I'm a constant voice imploring the left to stop begging giant social media to censor -- so that #BDS, #BLM and other progressive voices aren't silenced (more).
